title: Learning Human-Robot Collaboration via Heterogeneous-Agent Lyapunov Policy Optimization

layout.note: An upper layer holds the interaction-space box at the left, the two peach agent bands in the middle and the real-world photo at the right; a full-width grey band below holds the equation chain; vertical arrows hand over between the two layers.

lesson: Put the setting on top and the new algorithm in a full-width grey band underneath, joined by two coloured vertical arrows (signals down, update back up). Inside the band, equation boxes with a bold name above each formula and the step named on the arrows read as a derivation.
